# Design tokens

Every token of the official theme, generated from [`tokens/opendap.tokens.json`](../../tokens/opendap.tokens.json). The rules for using them are in the [design system](../specs/design-system.md). CSS custom properties are in `export/css/tokens.css` and Slint properties in the `Tokens` global of `export/slint/tokens.slint`; a dash means the platform cannot express the value and components draw it.

## `plasma`

Special visual mode (DS-009): never on routine screens; disabled as a group by the reduced-effects mode.

- `plasma.thermal`: Atmospheric layer of thermal refraction: three radial fields, blurred. Not optical displacement.
